profile.headline: Data & Analytics Platform Engineer  | AI-native Data Engineering · Python/SQL data pipelines · Tableau Server architecture at enterprise scale · AWS | M.S. Data Analytics & Applications, Washington University
profile.summary:
I build and run the data platforms that let thousands of people actually use their data.

At Charter Communications, I lead the architecture and administration of a large multi-node enterprise Tableau Server environment on AWS serving 15,000+ users — keeping it fast, highly available, and governed. Increasingly that means engineering: production Python against the Tableau REST and Metadata APIs to automate what used to be manual, turning platform operations into repeatable, monitored processes. When a problem is complex, ambiguous, or high-stakes, I'm the one called in — and for years, my answer has been to deliver.

My path here isn't the usual one. I started in cognitive science and neuroscience — running experiments, analyzing behavioral data, and publishing as a contributing author in the Journal of Neuroscience before I ever touched an enterprise server. That grounding in how people think, and how to make sense of messy real-world data, is exactly what I bring to analytics: the point was never dashboards for their own sake, but helping people see clearly and decide well.

Now I'm deepening the engineering side — pursuing an M.S. in Data Analytics & Applications at Washington University in St. Louis (Python, SQL, ETL and data engineering, machine learning, applied AI) and applying it directly to how our platform ingests, models, and serves data.

The world is abundant, complex, and full of nuance. My job is to help people make sense of it.

positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description:
- Lead administration and architecture of a large multi-node enterprise Tableau Server cluster on AWS serving 15k+ users — keeping it highly available and performant through governed multi-node design and routine upgrades.
- Build and maintain production Python automation against the Tableau REST and Metadata APIs — provisioning content, managing permissions, and extracting usage and lineage — replacing manual admin work with repeatable, monitored processes.
- Own governance and standardization across the analytics platform: certified data sources, promotion of content from lower to upper environments, and self-service enablement so thousands of users can safely find and understand their own data.
- Serve as the technical go-to for complex, ambiguous, high-stakes platform problems, and mentor the analytics/admin team on best practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Engineered and maintained enterprise Tableau Server environments across AWS, Linux, and Windows — handling upgrades, monitoring, and performance tuning to keep multi-node clusters reliable for a large, growing user base.
- Developed Python automation against the Tableau REST and Metadata APIs to streamline routine administration — content provisioning, permissions, and usage reporting — cutting manual effort and human error.
- Partnered with analytics teams and site administrators to promote governed, certified data sources and self-service best practices, helping end users find and trust their own data.
- Troubleshot complex issues across the full stack, from server configuration to data-source and extract optimization.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Deployed, monitored, and maintained multiple large enterprise Tableau Server environments across Linux and Windows, keeping them reliable for a growing user base.
- Led community initiatives to drive adoption — training, enablement, and outreach that turned the platform into something teams actually used.
- Helped establish a governed, self-service analytics platform so people across the business could find and understand their own data safely.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
- Server Architect/Administrator: Responsible for ensuring Sandbox, Development, User Acceptance Testing, and Production Enterprise Tableau Server Environments on Windows and Linux are up and running 99.999% of the time, routinely upgraded to stay current with latest releases, and are truly highly available, highly performant environments by following architecture best practices for multi-node clusters to support our continually growing user base and allow for governed promotion of content from lower to upper environments 
- Community Leader: Responsible for coordinating user groups/trainings thereby helping transform our admin team into a Tableau Center of Excellence where we regularly send out analytics newsletters, host user group meetings, build tableau self-service training workbooks, maintain data and analytics community intranet site, get strategic direction from our Steering Committee and work with Site Administrators to ensure we are following best practices and enabling all of our end users
- Development Intake/Lead: Responsible for leading a team of Tableau Developers helping our department see and understand our operations data utilizing Agile methodology and being the Analytics Team intake liaison to different lines of business
- Data Steward: Responsible for ensuring there are documented procedures/guidelines for data access, enterprise-wide content workflow procedures, and working with Site Administrators to encourage the use of certified published data sources for Tableau Creators and Explorers to create a truly governed self-service experience for analytics

positions.title: Associate System Administrator
positions.description:
- Server Administrator: Worked over 300+ tickets ranging from end users needing assistance with user access, general support questions, password resets on the server to assisting developers and data scientists with troubleshooting R scripts, optimizing data source extracts, enabling web data connectors and so much more on Tableau Server and Desktop, established better monitoring tools and participated in regular maintenance and upgrades
- Developer: Built out reports on an as-needed basis for other lines of business, including visualizations showing the current inventory, usage and burn rate of telephone numbers in different rate centers in Tableau and an analytical app to return call detail records based on a set of user input parameters in Alteryx as well as 10+ operational reports for leadership in my department around projects, headcount, capitalization, storage, SLAs, timesheets, and other team specific requests

positions.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
positions.description:
- Built enterprise data models in Idera ER/Studio to unify orders, accounts, and service requests from a newly acquired company into a single centralized database structure.
- Reverse-engineered production Oracle databases — validating primary/foreign keys, indexes, and relational structure — to rationalize and document the data architecture.
- Produced clear, documented data models so every team could understand the underlying structures.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
- Clairvoyant Consulting is a solo data practice helping small businesses turn the data they already have into a real advantage.
- Most small companies are sitting on valuable data — sales, customers, operations — that never becomes insight. I build the bridge: from raw, scattered data to clean, decision-ready dashboards and analytics, so owners can see their business clearly and act with foresight.
- It's enterprise-grade data and analytics — data engineering, Tableau, SQL, and Python automation, backed by 12+ years in the field — right-sized for a small business, without the enterprise price tag.
positions.insights: Skills: Analytics Engineering · Data Visualization · Machine Learning · Data Engineering · Statistics · Tableau · Design of Experiments · Business Intelligence (BI) · SQL · PostgreSQL · Data Warehousing · Data Modeling · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Research · Python (Programming Language) · Linux · Data Analysis

positions.title: Technology Solutions Specialist
positions.description:
- Co-founded a startup delivering custom hardware and software technology solutions for businesses and individuals.
- Stood up a full LAMP stack (Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP) integrated with Tableau to track inventory and sales — an early, end-to-end data pipeline built solo.
positions.insights: Skills: Analytics Engineering · Data Visualization · Machine Learning · Data Engineering · Statistics · Tableau · Design of Experiments · Business Intelligence (BI) · SQL · PostgreSQL · Data Warehousing · Data Modeling · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Research · Python (Programming Language) · Linux · Data Analysis

positions.title: Applied Behavior Analyst
positions.description:
- Delivered applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy to students with autism using a rigorous, data-driven method: collecting behavioral data, forming and testing hypotheses, and measuring outcomes across communication, academic, and social skills.
- Identified the antecedents of problem behaviors and designed effective, evidence-based interventions grounded in behavior-modification theory.
- Built the habit that still defines how I work: let the data show what's actually happening, then act on it.

- Built and delivered daily, mission-critical analytics for the board, executives, and managers — sourcing directly from production SQL databases and modeling the data into Tableau.
- Partnered across departments to clean, synthesize, and analyze operational data, turning raw records into decisions that measurably improved business processes.
- Delivered insight through Tableau, SQL, and custom reporting — surfacing the trends and inefficiencies that drove real efficiency gains across the company.

- Interned at the Open Door Learning Center supporting children aged 2–7 with autism.
- Worked alongside a team of Applied Behavior Analysis therapists to help each child grow across social, practical, emotional, cognitive, and academic skills — an early, hands-on grounding in how behavior and learning actually work.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Selected for George Mason's competitive Aspiring Summer Science Internship and then was asked to stay on for a full year working part time to conduct behavioral-neuroscience research under Dr. Ted Dumas at the Krasnow Institute for Advanced Studies — studying hippocampal-dependent spatial learning in juvenile rats via the Morris Water Maze.
- Ran a full experimental pipeline end to end: designing the study, running trials, and processing tissue — perfusion, cryostat sectioning, and in situ hybridization for analysis.
- Published as a contributing author in the Journal of Neuroscience.
